history.changes: Written as an App, Documents: documents received and issued, their list and their rules. No definition changes; what is approved is the App itself.
A received file keeps the day it arrived — the day an invoice outside KSeF counts as received.
Documents in and out: a received file is the fact, waiting for a reader; a file Rhea renders and hands over is an issued document, sealed by its hash.

description: Documents as received: the file is the fact, and this object is its place in state until a reader explains it Documents out (DIRECTION 2026-10-15, "Month end"): a file Rhea rendered and handed over is an issued_document — the writer, its parameters, the hash that seals it. The day a file arrived (2026-10-16): the door stamps its business date, and received_document keeps it as received_on — the day an invoice outside KSeF counts as received, read by the readers that turn the file into a purchase.

citations: every accounting suite keeps a tray of received documents ahead of their booking (the 'do zatwierdzenia' inbox of Polish SME suites, DATEV's Belege online); in Rhea the tray is the file itself under its hash, and this object is its status
a file re-read later by a newer channel amends this object and never changes the bytes — late understanding without rewriting the past
